title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: plumbing
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: In-ground drainage and sewer connection
swms.task: Excavate trenches up to 2.4 m deep in the basement and the street for in-ground sewer and stormwater drainage, using a 5 tonne excavator, then connect to the council sewer main in the street next to the road, open to traffic.

facts.trenchSupport: Trenches 1.5 m deep or more are shored with a trench shield rated for 3.0 m, as designed by the supplier's engineer.
facts.fallControl: Temporary fencing is placed 1 m back from open trench edges, and no one works at an unprotected edge.

swms.title: Cast-in sleeves and penetrations on the deck
swms.task: Install cast-in sleeves, puddle flanges and penetrations for plumbing on the deck of each post-tensioned floor before the pour, alongside the formwork and reo crews. Work is near the slab edge, more than 2 m above the floor below.

facts.fallControl: Work is done inside the perimeter screens and edge protection, and penetrations are covered as they are formed.

steps: Install cast-in sleeves and puddle flanges on the deck before the pour

swms.title: Core drilling through post-tensioned slabs
swms.task: Core drill penetrations for pipework through the post-tensioned slabs on each floor and in the basement. Open core holes are a fall of more than 2 m to the floor below.

facts.silicaControls: Core drilling is done wet with a water-fed rig, with fit tested P2 respirators worn while drilling, and the written silica assessment is done before work starts.
facts.fallControl: Each hole is covered with a fixed, marked cover as soon as it is cut, and the area below is barricaded during drilling.

swms.title: Hydraulic risers and pipework at height
swms.task: Install hydraulic risers and stacks in the shafts, and pipework in the basement ceilings and the double height foyer, working from elevating work platforms and ladders, more than 2 m above the floor.

facts.fallControl: Shafts are screened at each level with only the section being worked on opened, and elevating work platforms with guardrails are used for work above 2 m.

steps: Install risers and pipework at height

swms.title: Brazing and solvent cement joining
swms.task: Join copper pipe by brazing with oxy-acetylene torches, and join PVC pipe with primer and solvent cement, in the risers, the ceilings and the apartments.

facts.hotWorkPermit: The principal contractor issues a hot work permit each day; a fire watch stays for 30 minutes after hot work ends, with a fire extinguisher at each work area.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the primer and solvent cement: flammable liquids, use with ventilation, keep away from ignition sources, wear gloves and eye protection.
facts.fallControl: Joints in risers and ceilings are made from platforms with guardrails inside the screened shafts, or from elevating work platforms.

steps: Braze and solder pipe joints (hot work)
Join PVC pipe with primer and solvent cement
missing: Hot work permit and fire watch

swms.title: Pump rooms, pits and tanks; pressure testing and commissioning
swms.task: Install the pumps in the basement pump rooms, enter the sewage ejection pits and stormwater sumps to fit the pumps and pipework, then pressure test the pipework and commission the hot water systems.

facts.confinedSpace: An entry permit is issued for each entry. The air is tested for oxygen, flammable gas and toxic gas before entry and continuously during the work. A standby person stays at the opening, and the rescue plan with a tripod and winch is practised before work starts.
facts.pressureTesting: Pipework is hydrostatically tested with water to the design test pressure; the test area is barricaded and signed, and pressure is released through the drain valve before any fitting is touched.

steps: Prepare to enter the confined space
missing: Pits, tanks, sumps or manholes entered

swms.title: Apartment plumbing rough-in and fit-off
swms.task: Rough-in and fit-off the plumbing in the apartments: chase walls, install pipework, and fit tubs, toilets, basins and tapware, working from platform ladders.

facts.silicaControls: Chasing is done with on-tool dust extraction, with fit tested P2 respirators worn while chasing, and the written silica assessment is done before work starts.
